title: Pasta Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a dry pan until crispy, then remove from heat.
Beat eggs with grated parmesan and a generous pinch of black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving a cup of pasta water.
Add hot pasta to the pan with pancetta (off heat). Pour egg mixture over and toss quickly, adding a splash of pasta water to make it creamy.

title: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, squeeze in lemon juice, and season with salt.
Top with chili flakes and a poached egg if using.

title: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Heat olive oil in a pot, soften onion for 5 min, add garlic and spices, cook 1 min.
Add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, and stock. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 min until lentils are soft.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, then stir back in. Adjust seasoning.
